Absolutely. In simple terms, the main options are:

Dresses: the biggest category, if you want an easy full outfit in one piece
Tops: good if you want something flexible to pair with jeans, skirts, or trousers
Trousers: relaxed and easy everyday pieces, including wide-leg styles
Skirts: fewer options, but good if you want something light and easy to dress up or down
Bundles and co-ords: matching pieces picked to wear together, so styling is easiest
Kidswear bundles: value sets if you are shopping for children
